maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from collecting on purchased nonperforming consumer loan portfolios, not servicing or replacing installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue is collected from consumer debtors on bank and credit-issuer loans, not paid by government.

serial_acquirer.reason: It buys loan portfolios, not companies; growth comes from portfolio purchases and collections, with only occasional company acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Banks can sell nonperforming loan portfolios to competing debt buyers on price; switching buyers is easy.
